# BoomOpen Workflow Kit Pro (v5.5.0)

> Smart-Hybrid Multi-Agent Orchestration, Contract-First 3-Wave Swarm Sharding, Wave 2.5 Spec-to-Code Reconciliation, Stateful Multi-Round Project Audit (/audit), Multi-Session Project Autopilot, and Deterministic CLI Compiler Suite across 5 AI coding platforms (Google Antigravity 2.0, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).

## Canonical Inventory
- Version: v5.5.0
- Platforms (5): Antigravity 2.0, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot
- Slash Commands: 33 base commands (89 files: 83 workflows + 6 shared references, including /audit, /autopilot, /conduct, /cook, /code)
- Specialist Agents: 22 domain engineers & auditors
- Adversarial Teams: 18 Golden Diamond / Triangle teams (72 files)
- Skills Vault: 1,462 indexed skills (22 core + 1,440 library across 19 domains)
- Multilingual Routing: 17 supported languages

## Quick Install (From Git Clone)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Kennyboom/BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro.git
cd BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro
node cli/install.js install --all
node cli/install.js doctor
```

## Deterministic CLI Subcommands (14)
- `install` / `uninstall` / `list` / `doctor` / `settings`: SHA-256 manifest lifecycle & Control Center UI (`--ui`)
- `research` / `design` / `plan` / `cook` / `reconcile`: Static `< 50ms` artifact validators (`RES-G1..G4`, `DESIGN-G1..G4`, `PLAN-G1..G5`, `COOK-G1..G4`), wave packet compilers & Wave 2.5 spec-to-code reconciliation (`REC-G1..G4`)
- `audit` / `ledger` / `conduct` / `check`: Stateful multi-round human-gated project audit (`.boomopen/audit-ledger.json`), `.boomopen/project-ledger.json` phase ratchet, Multi-Engine Council (`claude,codex,antigravity`), and Pragmatic 2-Tier static gate (`--strict-phase --no-stubs`)
